editorial.blurb: Tank Kitchen & Bar brings Vietnamese flavors to life with impeccable hospitality, craft cocktails, and a refined atmosphere that feels both welcoming and elevated.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server (regulars rave about Lee and the friendly staff in black and hats) for the Lychee Kiss cocktail—it's a signature that never disappoints—and pair it with the tofu spring rolls and their standout peanut sauce.
signatureDishes: Lettuce wraps with yellow curry soup
